svg.title: wifihaven wordmark
svg.desc: The wifihaven wordmark in slate, all lowercase, set in a rounded sans-serif with mild negative letter-spacing. Brand font is Inter; Poppins/Nunito/system rounded sans are acceptable fallbacks.

text.font-family: Inter, Nunito, Poppins, 'SF Pro Rounded', ui-rounded, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
